english.title: Evade liability excise licence (disabled exemption)
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) on a public road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), being the person in charge of a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), to which the Vehicle Excise Duty (Immobilisation, Removal and Disposal of Vehicles) Regulations 1997 would apply but for the provisions of Regulation 4(1) and (2)(a) of those Regulations and the vehicle was not, at the time it was stationary, being used in accordance with Regulations under section 21 of the Chronically Sick and Disabled Persons Act 1970 and in circumstances falling within section 117(1)(b) of the Road Traffic Regulation Act 1984
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 8(1) of the Vehicle Excise Duty (Immobilisation, Removal and Disposal of Vehicles) Regulations 1997.

english.notes:
(i) Regulation 4(1) and 2(a) of these Regulations lists the circumstances under which these Regulations will not apply.
(ii) Section 21 of the Chronically Sick and Disabled Person's Act 1970 and Section 117 of the Road Traffic Regulation Act 1984 refer to badges on display on motor vehicles used by disabled persons and wrongful use of disabled person's badge respectively.
(iii) Statement of facts procedure applies - see end of document for wording.
